decisions.reason: Locked role labeled_reference_text is defined as plain text "not a link", but the source is the wiki interwiki link [[doi:10.1002/anie.197800161]] and the render makes it a link to https://doi.org/10.1002/anie.197800161. The link points at the reference's identifier, which is the identifier_link role. textual_mention does not fit because the DOI is this reference's identifier, not a mention. Reading is a judgement call: the written form contains a doi: label, but the role text excludes links.

corrected_label.notes: [[doi:...]] is an interwiki link whose target is the DOI; the render links it to //doi.org/<DOI> (mw:WikiLink/Interwiki). The guide defines labeled_reference_text as "not a link", so that role does not apply. It is a resolver link pointing at the reference's identifier, so identifier_link. The DOI key is unchanged.
